correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact graph model, reduction to uniform law, Helly/interval perfectness, two-dimensional Hoeffding projection, direct rational integrals, and n^(7/8) log n L2 maximum-to-median bound via DKW, Bernstein and fine-mesh endpoint occupancy. Exact finite-order verifier checks 41,064 endpoint orderings and 15 rational identities; it corroborates rather than replaces asymptotic proof. Limit covariance is positive definite and the Gaussian residual calculation gives variance 1/60.
